text.tspan: How each Helm version updates an object that someone edited by hand
on your laptop or CI runner = CSA
Sent as a plain Update: no owner check
Another owner + a different value → conflict
Helm 4: new installs use SSA. Upgrades use --server-side=auto, which reuses the apply_method stored in the release
(csa or ssa). So a release created by Helm 3 keeps the 3-way merge until one upgrade with --server-side=true.
